subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should #43367 remain the canonical multi-agent orchestration umbrella while focused fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with narrower canonical issues for completion delivery, fallback-lane ownership, orphaned locks, and detached-work cancellation?
rationale: The remaining failures span bugs plus product/API choices about session ownership, completion payloads, timeout fallback behavior, retry durability, and cancellation semantics, so automation should not choose the durable contract alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open while reviewing focused work such as #86540 and close it only after the linked delivery, lock, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Promote narrower open issues such as #86538, #89927, #92433, #49603, and #96975 to canonical owners before closing this umbrella.

options.title: Choose Completion-Isolation Contract
options.body: Make #96975 the product contract for subagent completion isolation and map delivery, lock, and fallback fixes around that direction.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while reviewing focused work such as #86540 and close it only after the linked delivery, lock, auth-noise, and detached-work symptoms are resolved or explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across the agent/session/config paths and the product architecture guardrails needed for this umbrella decision.
